description:
This role is for one of our clients 
 Compensation: $70 - $90 per hour 
 
 Role Type: Independent Contractor
 Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
 Schedule: Flexible – Work on your own schedule
 Payment Frequency: Weekly via Stripe or Wise
 About the Role
 We are seeking an experienced ML Kernel Engineer – AI Expert to evaluate the quality, correctness, and hardware-specific suitability of Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) development tasks used to train and assess advanced AI models.
 In this role, you will review and assess kernel implementations, focusing on CUDA-to-NKI migration fidelity, performance optimization for AWS Trainium hardware, and numerical correctness across different computing platforms. You will provide structured, rubric-based feedback to help improve the accuracy, efficiency, and hardware compatibility of AI-generated kernel code.
 The ideal candidate has hands-on experience developing or optimizing NKI kernels for AWS Trainium or Inferentia2, along with a strong understanding of GPU kernel development and accelerator-specific performance characteristics.
 Requirements 
 Key Responsibilities
 Evaluate NKI kernel implementations for code quality, correctness, efficiency, and hardware compatibility.
 Assess the fidelity and completeness of CUDA-to-NKI kernel migrations.
 Review Trainium-specific performance optimizations, including memory management, computation efficiency, and hardware resource utilization.
 Analyze tile-based computation, SBUF/PSUM/HBM memory hierarchy management, partition-dimension constraints, and DMA orchestration.
 Evaluate performance bottlenecks involving NeuronCore pipeline utilization, tensor-engine throughput, and memory bandwidth.
 Assess numerical consistency across GPU and Trainium platforms, including accumulation order, rounding behavior, and mixed-precision semantics.
 Identify implementation issues and provide clear, actionable feedback using structured evaluation rubrics.
 Help establish and assess standards for kernel correctness, performance, and cross-platform reliability.
 Basic Qualifications
 2+ years of hands-on experience developing or optimizing kernels using the Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) for AWS Trainium or Inferentia2 hardware.
 Strong understanding of NKI development patterns, including tile-based computation, SBUF/PSUM/HBM memory management, partition-dimension constraints, and DMA orchestration.
 Demonstrated experience evaluating CUDA-to-NKI kernel migrations.
 Familiarity with Trainium-specific performance profiling, including NeuronCore pipeline utilization, tensor-engine throughput, and memory-bandwidth bottlenecks.
 Experience defining or evaluating cross-platform numerical-correctness standards, including GPU-versus-Trainium accumulation order, rounding behavior, and mixed-precision semantics.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Direct experience with the AWS Neuron SDK, Neuron Compiler internals, or contributions to NKI kernel libraries.
 Previous experience developing CUDA or Triton kernels.
 Familiarity with Trainium hardware architecture, including NeuronCore-v2, on-chip SRAM topology, and supported data types such as FP32, BF16, FP8, and INT8.
 Experience benchmarking machine learning training workloads on AWS Trn1 or Trn2 instances.
 Contract and Payment Terms
 Engagement as an independent contractor.
 Fully remote role with a flexible schedule.
 Project duration may be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on business requirements and performance.
 Work will not require access to confidential or proprietary information belonging to any current or former employer, client, or institution.
 Payments are made weekly through Stripe or Wise, based on services rendered.
 H-1B and STEM OPT candidates cannot be supported at this time.
